blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–Ateneo completed an elimination-round sweep of National University with a 69-65 win on Wednesday in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Jared Bahay and Kieffer Alas hit clutch 3-pointers as the Blue Eagles got back on a winning track while snapping the Bulldogs’ four-game streak. Bahay broke out of a slump down the stretch with back-to-back triples to give Ateneo the lead, 65-62, with 1:19 remaining.
